decision: Do not reclassify CFSDS prior scars to generic non-fuel in the case builder until an authoritative succession rule and a compatible initial-state/damage-accounting contract are established.
purpose: Characterize whether the current pinned C++ importer accepts a historical burnt cell whose simulator fuel is NF.

result.expected_rejection: InitialState.csv marks a non-fuel/harvested cell as burned
result.interpretation: The C++ guard rejects the NF scar before producing a grid. The probe then reports an IndexError while looking for the absent initial grid; that wrapper error is secondary. This is an expected-rejection characterization, not a simulator-compatibility pass.
result.secondary_probe_error: IndexError: list index out of range

scope.data_split: upstream synthetic Sub20 fixture only; no CFSDS raster or validation/test outcome was opened
